verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online IP registry. Automated, headless filing or querying through an API is a plausible capability for such a service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes manual procedures (patent, trademark and design filings, renewals, online title requests) and shows no API, CLI or machine-to-machine automation. The llms.txt probe returned 404, so no agent-oriented docs are published either.
